instruction:
You are tasked with designing a verilog module that implements a 4-bit binary adder with carry-in and carry-out. The module should have two 4-bit input ports, one for each addend, and a single-bit input port for the carry-in. The module should also have two 4-bit output ports, one for the sum and one for the carry-out. You may assume that the input addends and carry-in will always be valid 4-bit binary values.

Write the verilog code for this module, including the module declaration, input and output ports, and the logic to perform the binary addition with carry-in and carry-out.
